The data also tags Figma AI with auto-layout and content generation, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it. Beyond that, the entry flags design system governance and adobe acquisition context, governance and dependency notes rather than technical specifications.

Figma sits at the application layer here, a product built on top of underlying compute rather than a claim on the compute itself, so this entry does not speak to the buildings or power behind it. Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to figma.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about Figma's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
Figma describes itself as "the collaborative canvas for design, code, and AI" where teams work together from concept to production in one place. The platform enables teammates and AI agents to work in the same space with shared context, generating new design directions, refining them, and aligning as a group.

Figma's AI product, Figma AI, provides design automation capabilities including auto-layout, content generation, and design system governance. The company is a publicly traded firm founded in 2012, headquartered in San Francisco, with ticker symbol FIG.
